page.title: Iinhlanganisi
page.intro: Xhumanisa ama-akhawunti wakho wokukhangisa. Ama-lead avela emikhangisweni yakho afika ku-My Leads ngokuzenzakalelako, ngokusebenzisa imali neendleko nge-lead ngayinye.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form liholela ema-Leads wami, ukusetjenziswa kwangamalanga kanye neendleko nge-lead ngayinye, kanye nekhwalithi ye-lead ethunyelwa emuva ku LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).

banner.connected: LinkedIn ixhumene. Ama-lead ayalandwa nje - ikhasi leli liyabuyekezwa msinyana.
banner.notConfigured: LinkedIn ayikahlelwa kule seva okwanje. Umlawuli kufanele afake ID yeklayenti yohlelo lokusebenza LinkedIn kanye nemfihlo.
banner.expired: Ukuxhumana LinkedIn kuphelelwe sikhathi, njeke ama-leads awavumelani. Hlanganisa godu ukuze uragele phambili.
banner.reconnectSoon: LinkedIn ifuna bona ungene godu nge {{date}} . Hlanganisa godu ngaphambi kwalokho ukugcina iinqophiso zigeleza.

connect.title: Hlanganisa LinkedIn
connect.intro: Ngena ngemvume nge-akhawunti LinkedIn elawula imikhangiso yakho. Leadrat ifunda kwaphela ama-akhawunti wakho weenkhangiso, ama-lead Lead Gen Form kanye neenbalo zemikhangiso, begodu ithumela amatjhuguluko owavulako.
connect.need1: Indima ku-akhawundi yomkhangiso LinkedIn (Umbukeli nofana ngaphezulu).
connect.need2: Indima ekhasini lenkampani elihlangeneko (Umlawuli, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Umgcini-mthetho nofana umhlaziyi) - LinkedIn ifuna bona yabelane ngama-lead.
connect.need3: Umbuzo wenomboro yomtato Lead Gen Forms - ama-lead ngaphandle kwenomboro yomtato angeze afakwa.

connection.title: Ukuxhumana
connection.syncResult: Ukuvumelanisa kwenziwe: {{received}} kwamukelwa, {{created}} kwakhiwa, {{duplicates}} aphindwe kabili, {{rejected}} kwaliwe.
connection.confirmDisconnect: Khupha LinkedIn ? Ukuvumelanisa kuyajama begodu amathokheni wokufinyelela ayasuswa. Ama-lead, iimbalo kanye nelogi yomsebenzi ziyagcinwa.
connection.noPermission: Ungabuka ikhasi leli. Ukuxhuma nokutjhugulula amasethingi kutlhoga imvumo "Phatha amasethingi".
connection.fetchHint: Ama-lead amatjha ahlolwa qobe ngemva kwemizuzu embalwa begodu amalanga ama-7 wokugcina ahlolwa godu qobe langa, ukwenzela bona akukho okulahlekileko. Sebenzisa lokhu malungana nama-lead wangaphambi kokuthi uxhumane, nofana ukuhlola isikhathi godu (ukufikela emalangeni ama-90 ngesikhathi). Iinqophiso esele zikhona ku Leadrat ziyeqiwe.
connection.fetchResult: {{from}} - {{to}} : {{received}} kutholwe, {{created}} kwakhiwa, {{duplicates}} aphindwe kabili, {{rejected}} kwaliwe, {{skipped}} sele kungenwe.

accounts.title: Ama-akhawundi weenkhangiso
accounts.intro: Ama-lead kanye neenbalo zivumelaniswa ukusuka kuma-akhawunti womkhangiso avuliwe lapha.
accounts.none: Awekho ama-akhawunti womkhangiso atholakeleko we-akhawunti LinkedIn . Hlola indima ye-akhawunti ku- LinkedIn Campaign Manager , bese uvuselela.
accounts.name: I-akhawundi yomkhangiso

settings.defaultCountryHint: Isetjenziswa lokha umdosiphambili nakathayipha inomboro yendawo (isib. 98765 43210). Iinomboro ezithoma ngo + zigcina inarha yazo.
settings.syncMinutes: Hlola LinkedIn ukuthola iinqophiso ezitjha qobe
settings.includeTestLeads: Godu ungenise iinqophiso zokuhlola ezenziwe ku- LinkedIn Campaign Manager

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Tjela LinkedIn bona ngimuphi umrholi wayo owaba lithemba lamambala. Lokha umdosiphambili LinkedIn nakafikelela esigabeni osikhethako ngezansi, Leadrat iyakubika ku LinkedIn , ukwenzela bona imibiko yakho yomkhankaso itjengise ikhwalithi yomdosiphambili begodu LinkedIn ingathola abantu abanengi abafana nomdosiphambili wakho omuhle khulu. Kuthunyelwa ID ye LinkedIn kwaphela kanye ne-hash ye-imeyili.
capi.created: Ukuguqulwa okwenziwe ku LinkedIn begodu kwamephu.

activity.title: Ilogo yomsebenzi
activity.intro: Konke hlangana ne Leadrat ne LinkedIn : ukuxhumana, woke ukuvumelanisa, woke umdosiphambili nokuthi kwenzekeni kiwo, ukutjhuguluka namaphutha.
